title: Grapes and Vines
summary: Grapes and vines were signs of fruitfulness, blessing, labor, and sometimes covenant unfaithfulness.
background: Vine imagery draws from common agriculture: planting, pruning, fruit, harvest, and care. Israel is often pictured as a vineyard under God’s inspection.
teachingHelp: Use vine passages to show fruitfulness, dependence, judgment, or Christ-centered union depending on context.
